industries.label: Nursing
industries.blurb: Ward, ICU and home-care nursing interviews.

roles.title: ICU / Critical Care Nurse
roles.summary: Care for critically ill and ventilated patients. Own monitoring, emergency response, infection control and tight teamwork with doctors.
responsibilities: Set nursing standards and own clinical quality metrics for the service line
Build staffing models that protect safety without burning out the team
Partner with physicians and hospital admin on escalation and capacity
Coach nurse managers and own hiring, retention, and culture
requirements: 10+ years in nursing with 5+ years of leadership
Track record improving quality, staffing, or patient-experience scores
questions: How do you decide when a staffing gap is a risk you can absorb versus a risk you must escalate?
Tell me about a quality indicator you owned that was off-track. What did you change?
Describe a conflict between a physician group and your nursing team. How did you handle it?
How do you retain experienced nurses when the market is hiring aggressively?

sampleResume.label: Sample: 14 yrs, Apollo
sampleResume.text:
DR. ANITA MENON, RN
Director of Nursing | 14 years
Apollo Hospitals, Chennai

SUMMARY
Nursing leader for a 180-bed medical-surgical and HDU cluster. Own nurse staffing, falls, pressure-injury, and HCAHPS-equivalent patient-experience scores. Calm in capacity crunches.

EXPERIENCE
Director of Nursing, Apollo Hospitals (2019–present)
- Reduced inpatient falls 32% over 12 months with intentional rounding and night-shift huddles.
- Cut agency spend 18% by redesigning the float pool and weekend rostering.
- Built a charge-nurse development path; 6 of 9 current managers were promoted internally.

Nurse Manager, ICU, Apollo (2014–2019)
- Led 42 ICU nurses; introduced a sepsis bundle checklist that improved door-to-antibiotic time.

Staff Nurse then Charge Nurse, Fortis (2012–2014)

EDUCATION
B.Sc Nursing, CMC Vellore; M.Sc Nursing Administration
Registered Nurse, Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council

SKILLS
Staffing models, clinical quality, physician partnership, JCI audit readiness, coaching.

roles.title: Staff Nurse
roles.summary: Deliver bedside care on a medical-surgical or specialty ward. Prioritize a full assignment, escalate deterioration early, and document with accuracy.
responsibilities: Own a patient assignment: assessments, meds, education, and handoff
Recognize and escalate deterioration using the unit's early-warning process
Coordinate with physicians, pharmacy, and allied health
requirements: 2–6 years as a registered nurse, preferably inpatient
Valid RN license; BLS required, ACLS preferred depending on unit
questions: Walk me through how you prioritize when you have six patients and two of them spike a fever at once.
Tell me about a time you escalated a deteriorating patient. What did you notice first?
How do you handle a family who is angry about wait times while you are mid-medication round?
Describe a medication or protocol near-miss you caught. What did you change afterward?

sampleResume.label: Sample: 4 yrs, Manipal
sampleResume.text:
ROHAN PATEL, RN
Registered Nurse | 4 years
Manipal Hospitals, Bengaluru, Medical-Surgical

SUMMARY
Bedside RN for a 36-bed med-surg ward. Comfortable with a 5–6 patient assignment, early-warning scores, and tight handoffs. Known for catching deterioration before it becomes a code.

EXPERIENCE
Staff Nurse, Manipal Hospitals (2022–present)
- Average assignment of 5 patients; charge-nurse backup on nights twice a month.
- Escalated a post-op patient with rising NEWS2; rapid response avoided ICU transfer delay.
- Precepted 4 new graduates on meds, documentation, and family communication.

Staff Nurse, Narayana Health (2022, 10 months)
- Ortho-trauma ward; learned high-volume admissions and drain/wound protocols.

EDUCATION
B.Sc Nursing, Manipal College of Nursing
RN, Karnataka State Nursing Council; BLS, ACLS

SKILLS
NEWS2, IV therapy, patient education, SBAR handoff, EMR (Cerner-equivalent).

roles.title: Home Care Nurse
roles.summary: Deliver nursing care in the patient's home. Work independently, keep families informed, and handle hygiene, medication and early signs of deterioration.
responsibilities: Complete home visits: assessment, meds, personal care, and documentation
Help with bathing, toileting, diaper care and safe moving of bedridden patients
Explain the care plan to family and escalate if the patient is worse than last visit
Keep visit notes so the next nurse can continue care safely
requirements: GNM / B.Sc Nursing with 0–3 years, including internship or home-care exposure
Comfortable with essential personal-care duties, including incontinence care
Calm communicator with patients and families in a home setting
questions: Walk me through a typical home visit from arrival to leaving the house.
How do you keep a patient safe when you are the only nurse in the home?
Tell me about helping with bathing, diaper care or toileting in a home setting.
What would you do if you found the patient worse than the last visit?
criteria: Independent judgement in a home setting
Hands-on personal care including hygiene and incontinence care

sampleResume.label: Sample: 2 yrs, Portea
sampleResume.text:
SANA SHEIKH, GNM
Home Care Nurse | 2 years
Portea Medical, Mumbai

SUMMARY
Home-care nurse for elderly and post-op patients. Comfortable with vitals, meds, bathing, diaper care and family teaching. Known for staying calm when a visit does not go as planned.

EXPERIENCE
Home Care Nurse, Portea (2024–present)
- 4–6 visits a day: vitals, wound care, injections, and personal hygiene including incontinence care.
- Escalated a post-op patient with rising fever and low BP; doctor visit the same evening avoided an emergency admission.
- Teach family turning and feeding so care continues between visits.

Staff Nurse intern, municipal hospital (2023–2024)
- Ward posting: meds, bed making, vital charts.

EDUCATION
GNM; Maharashtra Nursing Council; BLS

SKILLS
Home visits, vitals, IM/IV as trained, personal care, family education, visit notes.
